method: whole-process wall time, stdout discarded, median of the runs

columns.median_s: wall clock of the whole process, median of the runs
columns.cpu_median_s: user plus kernel time of the child, median of the runs
columns.peak_bytes: peak working set of the child, the largest of the runs
columns.make_s: wall clock of the one command that builds the timed artifact, 0 for node and bun
columns.gz_bytes: the contestant's single source file, gzipped at level 9

flags.vyrn-native: vyrn build (the module through wasm2c, clang -O2 -ffp-contract=off with wasm-rt)
flags.vyrn-wasm: vyrn build --target wasm (the emitter's module, no optimizer) + wasmtime run
flags.vyrn-wasm-opt: vyrn --wasm-opt build --target wasm (the emitter's module through wasm-opt -O3) + wasmtime run

revcomp.note: N is the fasta n; reverse-complement reads all 10n bases

knucleotide.note: N is the fasta n; k-nucleotide reads the 5n-base THREE sequence. This N was three orders of magnitude below the others while `Map` lookup was a linear scan and the program was quadratic in the number of distinct keys. Every map has a hash index and the key is an integer, so the reason is gone — and the old N left the row at 7 ms, close enough to the process floor that its cells drifted by multiples between runs while every other row held inside five per cent

mandelbrot.note: writes a binary PBM through `writeStdout`. The fixture stays at 200 because a PBM states its own dimensions; the timing N is 4,000 so the row lands in the same 0.5-5 s band as the others rather than at the process floor, where a scheduler hiccup is a multiple

regexredux.note: N is the fasta n. The engine is `std/regex`, written in Vyrn and run by all three backends. The timing N is 100,000 — a hundred times the fixture — so the row lands in the same 0.5-5 s band as the others; at the fixture size the whole run was 17 ms, close enough to the process floor that a scheduler hiccup showed up as a multiple
